text:
Alex P: Quick heads-up — I'm finishing the postmortem doc for last week's billing spike. We need clear owners for the token-count correction runbook and the invoice-adjustment playbook. Quick sync?
Mira K: Added a short action list in the doc. @Sam G can you take the runbook? I can own invoice corrections & customer comms.
Sam G: I can own the runbook. Will draft steps: recompute raw token deltas, validation checks, and a safe-adjust flow.
Rory L: FYI finance-bot found ~4k delayed usage events that didn't backfill due to a Kafka consumer offset regression. Looks like ingestion lag is the root cause for most deltas. @eng-sre-bot can you take the infra ticket?
eng-sre-bot: Created ENG-SRE-4821: "metering consumer offset monitoring + durable commit". ETA: EOD Thu. Adding alert on consumer lag > 5k events.
Alex P: Proposed timeline: runbook draft by Wed EOD, infra fix + monitoring by Fri, test remediation on staging Mon, customer remediation batch next Tue. Acceptable?
finance-bot: Automated scan: identified 12 invoices with >$100 discrepancy, 3 with >$5k. Spreadsheet: https://redwood.example/sheets/billing-deltas (internal).
Mira K: I'll own the invoice corrections. For credits >$5k we need legal sign-off — tagging Priya. I'll prepare a list with proposed credit amounts and notes.
Priya (Legal): Acknowledged. We'll prioritize reviews for these customers; aim to turnaround within 48 hours after Mira submits the list.
Sam G: Draft runbook snippet to be expanded:
```
steps:
1. Query raw metering events from 2026-02-20..2026-02-24 via metering-read (shard=all)
2. Recompute token counts using v2-metering logic (script: tools/recompute_tokens.py)
3. Output CSV with columns: customer_id, original_tokens, recomputed_tokens, delta
4. Create adjustments csv and send to billing-api /adjust with dry-run flag
5. Run validation compares: staging invoices vs recomputed totals
```
Will add rollback and sampling procedures.
Alex P: Add a hard stop: do not apply adjustments if negative deltas exceed 1% of monthly MRR or if >10% of a single customer's tokens change. Also add a manual approval gate for any >$5k credit.
Sam G: Will add approval gate and the alert threshold. Also adding a small QA checklist for sample customers.
Mira K: I'll run QA on a sample of 10 impacted customers and confirm amounts. :thumbsup:
Alex P: Owners summary: runbook = Sam G, infra = Rory L / ENG-SRE, invoice corrections = Mira K, legal sign-off = Priya. I'll own final sign-off & customer comms.
Rory L: For recurring pattern: I'll add a recurring radar check to detect future Kafka consumer regressions and surface weekly metrics to the console.
eng-sre-bot: Added dashboard: "Metering Consumer Lag" and scheduled weekly report to #eng-sre.
Priya (Legal): If any customer requests written confirmation of the adjustment, send to legal@redwood.example and we'll provide a template.
Alex P: OK — weekly checkpoint call on Fridays until closed. Please update the doc with links to tickets and mark tasks with owners + ETA. I'll follow up after Sam posts runbook draft. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
Sam G: Posting initial runbook draft in the doc now. Will ping when ready for review.
Mira K: Thanks — will prep the invoice spreadsheet and tagged customers list.
finance-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 7 days for owners' status.
